questions.question: A web service that provides resizable virtual servers in the cloud, giving you complete control over your computing resources including CPU, memory, storage, and networking configuration.
A serverless compute service that runs your code in response to events without provisioning or managing servers. You pay only for the compute time consumed and it scales automatically from zero.
A service that automatically adjusts the number of compute instances in response to changing demand, helping you maintain performance and minimize costs without manual intervention.
A fully managed container orchestration service that makes it easy to deploy, manage, and scale containerized Docker applications on AWS, with deep integration with other AWS services.
A managed service that makes it easy to run Kubernetes on AWS without needing to install, operate, or maintain your own Kubernetes control plane or worker nodes.

A serverless compute engine for containers that removes the need to provision and manage servers. You specify the CPU and memory for your container and it runs without managing the underlying infrastructure.
A platform-as-a-service that handles all the deployment details — capacity provisioning, load balancing, auto-scaling, and health monitoring — so developers only need to upload their code.
A fully managed service to run batch computing workloads of any scale. It dynamically provisions compute resources based on the volume and resource requirements of submitted batch jobs.
A service that extends AWS infrastructure, services, APIs, and tools to your on-premises facilities, enabling a truly consistent hybrid experience with the same hardware used in AWS data centers.
A simplified cloud platform designed for developers who need to build simple applications. It offers pre-configured bundles of compute, storage, and networking at a predictable monthly price.

A fully managed service that lets you build, deploy, and run containerized web applications and APIs without worrying about infrastructure. It automatically builds from source code or container images.

A fully managed object storage service offering industry-leading scalability, data availability, and security. It stores any amount of data from anywhere and is the backbone of many AWS data workflows.
A block storage service that provides persistent, high-performance volumes for use with Amazon EC2 instances. Volumes persist independently from the running life of an instance.
A fully managed, scalable shared file storage service (NFS protocol) that can be mounted on multiple EC2 instances simultaneously and grows and shrinks automatically as you add and remove files.
A low-cost cloud storage service for data archiving. It provides three retrieval options from milliseconds to hours, making it ideal for long-term backup and compliance archives.
A managed service that provides fully managed third-party high-performance file systems on AWS, including options for Windows file shares, Lustre (HPC), NetApp ONTAP, and OpenZFS.
A hybrid cloud storage service that gives your on-premises applications seamless access to virtually unlimited cloud storage. It connects on-premises software appliances to cloud-based storage.
A centralized service to automate backup of data across AWS services, letting you define backup policies and monitor backup activity from a single place across your entire organization.
A service that lets you provision a logically isolated section of the AWS Cloud where you can launch AWS resources in a virtual network that you define, with full control over routing and security.
A global content delivery network service that securely delivers data, videos, and applications to users worldwide with low latency using a network of edge locations.
A service that automatically distributes incoming application traffic across multiple targets — such as EC2 instances, containers, and IP addresses — in one or more Availability Zones.
A fully managed service that makes it easy for developers to create, publish, maintain, monitor, and secure REST, HTTP, and WebSocket APIs at any scale.
A highly available and scalable DNS web service that also provides domain registration and traffic routing policies such as latency-based, geolocation, and failover routing.
A service that provides a dedicated private network connection from your data center to AWS, bypassing the public internet to reduce latency and increase bandwidth consistency.
A networking service that improves global application availability and performance by routing traffic through the AWS global network to optimal endpoints rather than the public internet.
A hub-and-spoke networking service that allows you to connect thousands of VPCs and on-premises networks through a single gateway, simplifying your network topology at scale.
A technology that provides private connectivity between VPCs and AWS services, or your own services, without exposing traffic to the public internet or requiring VPC peering or gateways.
A service mesh that provides application-level networking for microservices, giving you visibility and control over communications between your services regardless of how they are implemented.

A managed relational database service that supports multiple engines including MySQL, PostgreSQL, MariaDB, Oracle, and SQL Server. It automates time-consuming tasks such as hardware provisioning, database setup, patching, and backups.
A fully managed NoSQL database service offering single-digit millisecond performance at any scale. It supports both key-value and document data models with automatic scaling.
A cloud-native, MySQL and PostgreSQL-compatible relational database built for the cloud that is up to 5x faster than standard MySQL and 3x faster than standard PostgreSQL.

A fully managed in-memory caching service supporting Redis and Memcached. It improves application performance by retrieving data from fast in-memory caches instead of relying on slower disk-based databases.
A fast, fully managed, petabyte-scale data warehouse that makes it simple and cost-effective to analyze all your data using standard SQL queries and existing business intelligence tools.
A fully managed graph database service that makes it easy to build and run applications with highly connected data. It supports Gremlin and SPARQL query languages for property graphs and RDF graphs.
A fully managed document database service that is MongoDB-compatible, allowing you to use existing MongoDB drivers and tools while benefiting from managed infrastructure.
A purpose-built time-series database service that makes it fast and cost-effective to store and analyze trillions of events per day from IoT sensors, DevOps monitoring, and industrial telemetry.

A fully managed ledger database that provides a transparent, immutable, and cryptographically verifiable transaction log owned by a central trusted authority, ideal for supply chain and financial records.
A service that enables you to manage access to AWS services and resources securely by creating and managing users, groups, roles, and policies that define what actions identities can perform.

A managed service that makes it easy to create and control the encryption keys used to encrypt your data. It integrates with most AWS services and provides centralized key management with audit logging.

A web application firewall that protects your web applications and APIs against common web exploits such as SQL injection and cross-site scripting (XSS) that could affect availability or compromise security.

A service that helps you protect access to your applications and IT resources by enabling you to easily rotate, manage, and retrieve database credentials, API keys, and other secrets throughout their lifecycle.
A service that lets you easily provision, manage, and deploy public and private SSL/TLS certificates for use with AWS services and your internal connected resources.

A vulnerability management service that continually scans your AWS workloads — including EC2 instances, Lambda functions, and container images — for software vulnerabilities and unintended network exposure.
A threat detection service that continuously monitors your AWS accounts and workloads using machine learning, anomaly detection, and integrated threat intelligence to identify malicious activity.
A fully managed identity service that adds user authentication and authorization to your web and mobile applications, allowing users to sign in directly or through social identity providers.
A data security service that uses machine learning to automatically discover, classify, and protect sensitive data such as PII stored in Amazon S3.
A managed DDoS protection service that safeguards applications on AWS. It provides always-on detection and automatic inline mitigations to minimize application downtime and latency.
A cloud security posture management service that aggregates security findings from multiple AWS services and partner solutions into a single dashboard for a comprehensive view of your security state.
A security management service that lets you centrally configure and manage firewall rules across your accounts and applications in AWS Organizations, ensuring consistent policy enforcement.
A stateful managed network firewall service for your VPC that provides fine-grained control over network traffic using stateful rules, domain-based filtering, and intrusion prevention.
A managed service that provides dedicated hardware security modules in the cloud, allowing you to generate and use your own encryption keys with FIPS 140-2 Level 3 validated hardware.

A security investigation service that uses machine learning to automatically collect log data and conduct security investigations, helping you analyze, identify, and quickly get to the root cause of security findings.
A monitoring and observability service that collects metrics, logs, and events from AWS resources and applications, enabling you to set alarms, visualize data, and automatically react to changes.
A service that provides centralized governance for multiple AWS accounts, allowing you to apply policies, control access, and automate account creation using service control policies.
An operations hub that provides a unified interface for viewing, controlling, and automating operational tasks across AWS resources, including patching, run commands, and parameter storage.
A governance and audit service that records all API calls made in your AWS account, including the identity of the caller, the time of the call, and the source IP address, stored in S3.
A service that continuously records and evaluates your AWS resource configurations against desired settings, enabling compliance auditing, change management, and security analysis.
A service that lets you model your entire cloud infrastructure in text files and provision all resources together as a single deployable unit called a stack, enabling infrastructure as code.

An online tool that provides real-time guidance to help you provision your AWS resources following AWS best practices across five categories: cost optimization, performance, security, fault tolerance, and service limits.
A tool that lets you visualize, understand, and manage your AWS costs and usage over time, with the ability to filter and group data and create custom reports and forecasts.
A service that enables you to securely share AWS resources across multiple AWS accounts within your organization without duplicating them, reducing operational overhead and costs.
A managed service that automates the setup of a secure, multi-account AWS environment (landing zone) and applies ongoing governance through pre-packaged guardrails.
A service that allows IT administrators to create and manage a curated catalog of approved cloud products and resources that users within an organization can browse and deploy.

A service that analyzes your AWS compute usage and recommends optimal compute resources — such as EC2 instance types, Auto Scaling groups, and Lambda function memory — to reduce cost and improve performance.
A fully managed message queuing service that enables you to decouple and scale microservices and distributed systems. It stores messages until a consumer processes and deletes them.
A serverless event bus service that connects application data from your own apps, SaaS apps, and AWS services, enabling event-driven architectures with routing rules and schema discovery.
A fully managed pub/sub messaging service that fans out messages to a large number of subscribers including SQS queues, Lambda functions, HTTP/S endpoints, and email addresses simultaneously.
A visual workflow service that lets you coordinate the components of distributed applications using state machines. It orchestrates sequences of tasks with built-in error handling and retry logic.
A cloud-based email sending service designed to help digital marketers and application developers send marketing, notification, and transactional emails at scale.
A no-code integration service that enables bi-directional data flows between AWS services and SaaS applications like Salesforce, ServiceNow, and Slack, on a schedule or triggered by events.
A managed message broker service that supports industry-standard messaging protocols such as AMQP (ActiveMQ) and STOMP (RabbitMQ), enabling migration of existing message brokers to the cloud.

A fully managed GraphQL API service that simplifies application development by letting you create flexible APIs so applications can access, manipulate, and receive real-time updates from multiple data sources.

A managed service for real-time processing of streaming data at any scale. It can continuously capture gigabytes of data per second from many sources such as application logs, IoT telemetry, and clickstreams.
A serverless interactive query service that makes it easy to analyze data directly in Amazon S3 using standard SQL. There is no infrastructure to manage — you pay only for the queries that you run.
A serverless ETL service and centralized data catalog that discovers your data, transforms it, and makes it available for search and querying without the need to manage infrastructure.
A managed big data platform that makes it easy and cost-effective to run Apache Hadoop, Spark, HBase, Presto, and other frameworks to process vast amounts of data.
A fast, cloud-native BI service that makes it easy to create and publish interactive dashboards and ML-powered insights accessible from any device, including embedded in applications.

A managed search and analytics service (successor to Amazon Elasticsearch Service) that makes it easy to deploy, operate, and scale a search engine for log analytics, real-time application monitoring, and full-text search.
A service that makes it easy to set up, secure, and manage data lakes on Amazon S3, including data ingestion, cataloging, and fine-grained access control for analytics workloads.
A fully managed Apache Kafka service that makes it easy to ingest and process streaming data, enabling you to run Kafka workloads without managing the underlying infrastructure.
A web service that helps you reliably process and move data between different AWS compute and storage services, as well as on-premises data sources, at specified intervals.
An online data transfer service that automates and accelerates moving large amounts of data between on-premises storage systems and AWS storage services using a software agent.
A managed database migration service that helps you migrate databases to AWS quickly and securely with minimal downtime. The source database remains operational during the migration.
A family of physical devices used to collect, process, and transfer large amounts of data offline to AWS when network bandwidth is insufficient, ranging from terabytes to exabytes of capacity.
A service that provides a single location to track the progress of application migrations across multiple AWS and partner migration tools, giving visibility into the status of each migration.
A service that incrementally replicates your on-premises VMware vSphere and Microsoft Hyper-V VMs to AWS, enabling you to migrate virtual machines to AWS with minimal downtime.

An application migration service that simplifies and expedites migration of applications to AWS by automatically converting source servers to run natively on AWS, supporting both rehost and replatform strategies.
A fully managed platform that provides every developer and data scientist with the tools to build, train, tune, and deploy machine learning models quickly at scale without managing infrastructure.

A natural language processing (NLP) service that uses machine learning to find insights and relationships in text, including sentiment analysis, key phrase extraction, entity recognition, and topic modeling.
A fully managed ML service that uses statistical and machine learning algorithms to deliver highly accurate time-series forecasts without requiring prior ML experience.
A computer vision service that makes it easy to add image and video analysis to your applications, detecting objects, scenes, activities, text, faces, and celebrities.
A document analysis service that automatically extracts text, handwriting, and structured data such as forms and tables from scanned documents, going beyond simple OCR.
An automatic speech recognition (ASR) service that makes it easy to add speech-to-text capability to your applications, supporting multiple languages and custom vocabulary.
A service for building conversational interfaces into any application using voice and text. It uses the same deep learning technologies that power Alexa to recognize intent and manage dialogue.
A text-to-speech service that turns text into lifelike speech, allowing you to create applications that talk and build speech-enabled products in dozens of languages and voices.
A neural machine translation service that delivers fast, high-quality, and affordable language translation between supported languages, enabling localization of content for diverse global users.

A distributed tracing service that helps developers analyze and debug production and distributed applications. It provides an end-to-end view of requests as they travel through your application, identifying performance bottlenecks.
